days.description: The Marangu Route is the oldest and most established path to the summit of Kilimanjaro — a trail that passes through four distinct ecological zones, takes you through some of the mountain's most extraordinary endemic flora, and culminates at Uhuru Peak in a midnight push across snow and scree that has been completed by climbers of every age, background, and fitness level since the 1890s. It is called the "Coca-Cola Route" not because it is easy — no route on a 5,895-metre volcano is easy — but because its hut accommodation and clear, well-worn trail make it the most accessible entry days.description: 7.00am pick up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Serengeti National Park with packed lunch. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area with a stop for a breath-taking view over the Ngorongoro Crater before continuing to the Serengeti National Park. Serengeti means 'endless plains' in the language of the Maasai and you will see the grassland savannah stretching to the horizon. Bizarre rock formations called kopjes dot the grassy landscape where predators are often seen. Depending on the season you will witness the migration of thousands of animals for which this park is famous for. Arrive at Seronera campsite / Serengeti Heritage Luxury Tented Camp for dinner and overnight in the Seronera Valley in the central Serengeti in the late afternoon after a game drive through the central Serengeti.","activities":["Hotel pick up in Arusha","Drive to Serengeti National Park","Scenic stop at Ngorongoro Crater viewpoint","Game drive through central Serengeti","Overnight at Seronera campsite / Serengeti Heritage Luxury Tented Camp"],"hotel_name":"Seronera campsite / Serengeti Heritage Luxury Tented Camp","city_name":"Seronera, Central Serengeti","place_id":null,"star_rating":4},{"day":2,"title":"Serengeti","description":"After breakfast, full day game drive in the Serengeti National Park. Inside the world's largest caldera, you will see a diversity of wildlife ranging from black rhinos, Grant's and Thomson's gazelles, lions and leopards to elephants and mountain reedbucks in the forests on the slopes. days.description: 7.00am pick up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Serengeti National Park with packed lunch. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area with a stop for a breath-taking view over the Ngorongoro Crater before continuing to the Serengeti National Park. Serengeti means 'endless plains' in the language of the Maasai and you will see the grassland savannah stretching to the horizon. Bizarre rock formations called kopjes dot the grassy landscape where predators are often seen. Depending on the season you will witness the migration of thousands of animals for which this park is famous for. days.description: 7.00am pick up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Serengeti National Park with packed lunch. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area with a stop for a breath-taking view over the Ngorongoro Crater before continuing to the Serengeti National Park. Serengeti means 'endless plains' in the language of the Maasai and you will see the grassland savannah stretching to the horizon. days.description: 7.00am pick up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Serengeti National Park with packed lunch. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area with a stop for a breath-taking view over the Ngorongoro Crater before continuing to the Serengeti National Park. Serengeti means 'endless plains' in the language of the Maasai and you will see the grassland savannah stretching to the horizon. Bizarre rock formations called kopjes dot the grassy landscape where predators are often seen. Depending on the season you will witness the migration of thousands of animals for which this park is famous for. After lunch at a picnic site, drive in direction of the Ngorongoro Crater. As soon as you have reached the edge of the crater, the caldera opens up before you. You might also see buffaloes, spotted hyenas, rare wild dogs and some of the more than 500 bird species of the area. days.description: 7.00am pick up from your hotel in Arusha, drive to Serengeti National Park with packed lunch. Travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area with a stop for a breath-taking view over the Ngorongoro Crater before continuing to the Serengeti National Park. Serengeti means 'endless plains' in the language of the Maasai and you will see the grassland savannah stretching to the horizon.
